I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live weather feeds right now, so I can’t tell you what the exact temperature or “feeling” is at this moment in Tel Aviv.  

If you’re looking for up‑to‑date numbers, you’ll probably find the most reliable information directly through:

* A trusted weather website (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather)  
* Your phone’s native weather app  
* Local news outlets or official meteorological services  

Those will give you the current temperature in Celsius or Fahrenheit along with wind chill, humidity, etc.  

In case you’d just like a quick reference point, Tel Aviv typically enjoys mild winters (around 50–60 °F / 10–15 °C) and warm summers (often 80–90 °F / 27–32 °C), but those figures only describe averages—not the present instant.
